code: native_diff <- function(r_scores, file) {   native <- read.delim(file.path(tip49, file), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)   both <- merge(native, r_scores, by = c("Bait", "Prey"), suffixes = c("_native", "_r"))   vapply(c("AvgP", "MaxP", "SaintScore", "BFDR"), function(column) {     max(abs(both[[paste0(column, "_native")]] - both[[paste0(column, "_r")]]))   }, numeric(1)) } rbind(   spc = native_diff(scores, "list_spc.txt"),   int = native_diff(scores_int, "list_int.txt") ) #>      AvgP  MaxP SaintScore BFDR #> spc 0.000 0.000      0.000 0.00 #> int 0.004 0.004      0.004 0.02

text: Quantitative proteomics data often held container: SummarizedExperiment, assay QFeatures object, ExpressionSet, anndataR object data exchanged Python. saintexpress depends none . holds three pieces run_saint() needs: function scores SummarizedExperiment returns scores SummarizedExperiment preys rows baits columns. needs SummarizedExperiment package; steps work accessors containers. put TIP49 counts SummarizedExperiment score :
code: run_saint_se <- function(se, assay = 1, bait = "bait", cort = "CorT",                          mode = "spc", ...) {   quant <- SummarizedExperiment::assay(se, assay)   samples <- SummarizedExperiment::colData(se)   inter <- as.data.frame(as.table(quant), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)   names(inter) <- c("preyId", "ipId", "quant")   inter <- inter[!is.na(inter$quant) & inter$quant > 0, ]   inter$baitId <- samples[[bait]][match(inter$ipId, colnames(se))]   si <- list(     inter = inter[, c("ipId", "baitId", "preyId", "quant")],     prey = data.frame(preyId = rownames(se)),     bait = data.frame(ipId = colnames(se), baitId = samples[[bait]],                       CorT = samples[[cort]])   )   scores <- run_saint(si, mode = mode, ...)    baits <- sort(unique(scores$Bait))   cell <- cbind(match(scores$Prey, rownames(se)), match(scores$Bait, baits))   to_matrix <- function(column) {     m <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow(se), length(baits),                 dimnames = list(rownames(se), baits))     m[cell] <- scores[[column]]     m   }   columns <- c("AvgP", "MaxP", "SaintScore", "FoldChange", "BFDR")   SummarizedExperiment::SummarizedExperiment(     assays = setNames(lapply(columns, to_matrix), columns),     rowData = SummarizedExperiment::rowData(se),     colData = data.frame(bait = baits, row.names = baits)   ) } counts <- tapply(   si$inter[[4]],   list(factor(si$inter[[3]], levels = si$prey[[1]]),        factor(si$inter[[1]], levels = si$bait[[1]])),   sum ) se <- SummarizedExperiment::SummarizedExperiment(   assays = list(counts = counts),   rowData = data.frame(length = si$prey[[2]], row.names = si$prey[[1]]),   colData = data.frame(bait = si$bait[[2]], CorT = si$bait[[3]],                        row.names = si$bait[[1]]) ) se #> class: SummarizedExperiment  #> dim: 1207 44  #> metadata(0): #> assays(1): counts #> rownames(1207): ACTR5 RUVBL2 ... TTC27 ECD #> rowData names(1): length #> colnames(44): ARP5 ARP6_1 ... 8 9 #> colData names(2): bait CorT  scores_se <- run_saint_se(se) scores_se #> class: SummarizedExperiment  #> dim: 1207 27  #> metadata(0): #> assays(5): AvgP MaxP SaintScore FoldChange BFDR #> rownames(1207): ACTR5 RUVBL2 ... TTC27 ECD #> rowData names(1): length #> colnames(27): ACTR5 ACTR6 ... ZNHIT2 ZNHIT6 #> colData names(1): bait SummarizedExperiment::assay(scores_se, "BFDR")[c("ACTR5", "ACTR8", "INO80B"),                                               c("RUVBL1", "RUVBL2", "INO80B")] #>        RUVBL1 RUVBL2 INO80B #> ACTR5    0.00      0   0.00 #> ACTR8    0.00      0   0.00 #> INO80B   0.37      0   0.37
